data.description:
Discovered during audit of CG-0MT1CIWSD003VBPK (discovered-from:CG-0MT1CIWSD003VBPK).

The audit skill's child persistence path (persist_audit.py -> wl audit-set <id> --ready-to-close no) unconditionally triggers wl's revertToPlanComplete() (WL-0MSKHYI5U0069FVV): any completed/in_review item with an audit verdict 'No' is reverted to open/plan_complete, and its dependency-descendants are auto-blocked.

Impact observed: an infra-fallback run (audit semaphore concurrency limit) persisted 'No' for all 9 children of CG-0MT1CIWSD003VBPK at 16:37:41-50Z, demoting all 9 from completed/in_review to open/blocked + plan_complete. An infra-fallback 'No' is not an explicit model assessment (SA-0MSG9SLGI002OF7V) and must not demote. Children were manually restored 2026-08-24.

ACs:
1. Audit runner/persist path for child audits distinguishes infra-fallback 'No' from genuine model 'No' and does not demote children on the former (restore semantics per SA-0MSG9SLGI002OF7V applied to children).
2. When a parent audit persists child verdicts, child lifecycle transitions are only applied when the verdict is a genuine model assessment; descendants are not auto-blocked by stale/fallback child audits.
3. A regression test covers: child at completed/in_review + parent-persisted fallback 'No' child audit -> child stays completed/in_review and descendants stay unblocked.
4. Documented in AGENTS.md / audit skill SKILL.md that wl audit-set carries its own revert side-effect; persist path must neutralize it (e.g. pass explicit stage/if-stage guard or restore after).
data.title: Audit infra: wl audit-set 'no' reverts parent-persisted child audits, demoting completed/in_review children (and descendants blocked)
